text: VAE is a neural network that transforms a standard RGB image into latent space representation and back. Latent space representation is what stable diffusion is working on during sampling (i.e. when the progress bar is between empty and full). For txt2img, VAE is used to create a resulting image after the sampling is finished. For img2img, VAE is used to process user's input image before the sampling, and to create an image after sampling.
html:
<abbr title="Variational autoencoder">VAE</abbr> is a neural network that transforms a standard <abbr title="red/green/blue">RGB</abbr>
image into latent space representation and back. Latent space representation is what stable diffusion is working on during sampling
(i.e. when the progress bar is between empty and full). For txt2img, VAE is used to create a resulting image after the sampling is finished.
For img2img, VAE is used to process user's input image before the sampling, and to create an image after sampling.

text: This page allows you to change default values in UI elements on other tabs.Make your changes, press 'View changes' to review the changed default values,then press 'Apply' to write them to C:\ForgeStudio\forge\webui\ui-config.json.New defaults will apply after you restart the UI.
html:
This page allows you to change default values in UI elements on other tabs.
Make your changes, press 'View changes' to review the changed default values,
then press 'Apply' to write them to C:\ForgeStudio\forge\webui\ui-config.json.
New defaults will apply after you restart the UI.
